static_traits.name: 韩宇
static_traits.family_status: 三兄弟姐妹中的中间孩子
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive family and friends, but finds it hard to share specific fears about the marriage with them
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似心理问题就诊史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 态度偏消极；能清晰表达具体担忧并给出情境示例；愿意配合尝试改变；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直对即将到来的婚姻感到Anxiety，具体来说，害怕丈夫会认为我是个糟糕的妻子，并最终离开我。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望在婚礼前有效管理强烈的Anxiety感，避免其影响心理健康与伴侣关系。
growth_experiences: Family of origin and social support: the middle child among three siblings; has supportive family and friends, but finds it difficult to share specific fears about marriage, making the help-seeking experience limited.
重要生活事件：Engaged后开始出现与婚姻相关的Anxiety，随着婚期临近而逐渐加重；每日在想象与not yet来丈夫的相处情景时出现强烈担忧，影响睡眠、食欲与工作表现。

core_beliefs: I will be abandoned by my partner

special_situations.event: Wedding approaching (getting married in six months)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能成为“完美妻子”，丈夫就会认为我not好并离开我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated overthinking; tries discussing with family and friends but avoids deeply expressing specific fears

special_situations.event: 想到与not yet来丈夫的具体相处情境（例如家务not够完美）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家务not完美，就说明我是失败的、not称职的妻子
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously assuming the worst case and rehearsing argument outcomes in the mind
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Small problems will escalate into big arguments, and in the end he will leave

special_situations.event: Faces society's expectations and standards for the 'perfect wife'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must meet these external standards, otherwise I am a bad wife
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我施压与Self-monitoring，反复检查是否“够好”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should do it perfectly, otherwise I will be disliked

special_situations.event: When talking about worries with family and friends, the other party only says 'everything will be fine'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们not回应我的具体恐惧，说明我的担忧not被理解或被视为夸张
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing specific fears and instead bears them alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我小题大做/他会看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be steadily accepted and recognized by her partner, becoming a 'good enough' partner
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为not够好而被抛弃
defense_goal: 通过预先担忧与自我苛责来保持控制感，避免关系中的失败与Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能被嫌弃与抛弃的伴侣
object_relations.object_representation: The harsh partner with implicit high standards who may leave
好心但without法理解具体Anxiety、以空泛安慰回应的家人朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes challenging negative beliefs, restructuring thoughts, or behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为改变思维是“自欺”，担心自己的真实感受会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、同理的语气；承认其感受的真实；以开放式问题邀请举例与检验证据；避免评判与对抗；语速平稳，逐步共构替代解释。

manifestations: 与亲友分享具体恐惧困难；对方安慰without法缓解感受
Bound by society's expectation of a 'perfect wife'

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Taking the social expectation of a 'perfect wife' as a standard that must be followed
频繁以“应该/必须”自我要求

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 过度在意是否达标、担心“not够好”

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on。
manifestations: 被问到具体trigger时先说“have not”，随后泛化为“社会压力”
Even with relatives' and friends' support, still hard to enter the details of specific fears

positive_force: 伴侣一直表现出支持与爱护
Willing to seek counseling and try to change (clear motivation)
Has a supportive network of family and friends
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来、读心术、过度概括等认知偏差显著
将社会期待Introjection为僵化的“应该”标准，导致自我苛责
与亲友在具体恐惧上的沟通困难，支持not yet能触及核心担忧
持续过度担忧引发Disturbed sleep and appetite，工作表现受损

target_behavior.behavior: 对Marriage and relationships的灾难化Anticipation与过度担忧（广泛性Anxiety）
antecedent: Wedding approaching (getting married in six months)
想到与not yet来丈夫的具体相处情境（如家务not够完美）
Faces society's expectations and comparisons regarding the 'perfect wife'
target_behavior.core_reason: 对被伴侣抛弃的恐惧与对“完美妻子”外界标准的Introjection，伴随认知偏差（灾难化、预测not yet来、读心术、过度概括）
target_behavior.function: 通过预先担忧与Self-monitoring来试图获得控制感、避免被评判与Being rejected的风险（逃避潜在负性结果）
target_behavior.consequence: Disturbed sleep and appetite、Decline in work performance、与亲友沟通受限、持续高水平Anxiety
